ACCEPT — exact V2 incorporates all four accepted repairs and introduces no blocker-class contradiction.

- The two-acquisition-run ClockRepair now targets a dedicated synthetic diagnostic axis; edition TrackComposition remains a separate C1-D family, matching B0 decision post-01M19ERGZJXV8XSS6HR1FTDZQK.
- C1-F and synthetic-record accounting are restored with absent, nonempty and legacy-empty AudioSpan, packet-duration unknown, retained and break-dropped records, optional/missing TR, missing coordinate, overlap/all-preimages, within-run and reject/split cross-break cases, plus exactly one closed disposition per synthetic record.
- Expected outcomes are closed and tagged by input family. Missing-anchor Unestablished is distinct from relation refusal and projection refusal; reverse singleton/set/hold/ambiguity cases are exact; D04 is split into deterministic cases.
- ExpectedDataId hashes the complete canonical semantic payload and freezes exact identity preimages/constants. OracleRealizationId is correctly undefined here; later F0 must bind exact realized coverage and F0 Intent/request identity, so partial realization cannot claim the full artifact.

The reset, diagnostic gap, epoch/occurrence identity, non-bridging composition, mutation/control pairing, independent arithmetic/identity recomputation, JVM/JS/Native gate, F0 V3 compatibility and documentation-only claim ceiling are exact. This ACCEPT grants no code, source, runtime, dependency, provider or implementation authority.
